gohighlevel.label: HighLevel (GoHighLevel) affiliate program
gohighlevel.terms: 40% recurring commission for the life of the customer on Starter, Unlimited, Agency Pro and White Label Mobile App; 5% second tier. A sale counts once the customer account stays in good standing for 45 days. $50 payout minimum; commissions under $50 in a 120-day window are forfeited.
gohighlevel.payoutRail: Tipalti (set up; monthly, Net-15, paid on the 15th once commissions pass $50)

rules.mandatoryDisclosure: I am an independent entity from HighLevel. I am not an agent or employee of HighLevel and have no authority to make any binding commitment on behalf of HighLevel.

gohighlevel.notes: The account (FirstPromoter portal: gohighlevel.firstpromoter.com) is shared with the owner’s other sites, so every CinchStack link keeps the account’s referral code and adds a Sub ID naming the page it sits on (fp_sid=cinchstack-<page path>, e.g. cinchstack-tools-gohighlevel-pricing). Signups from this site therefore show separately, page by page, under Reports > Sub Ids. Do not change the referral code with “Customize Token”: that would break the links already placed on the other sites. HighLevel’s own ready-made links put fp_ref on deep pages (e.g. /pricing), so each button lands on the page it names.

shopify.label: Shopify affiliate program
shopify.terms: Bounty per referred merchant who becomes paying, up to $150 depending on merchant country; long tracking window.
shopify.notes: Applied 27 September 2026 (UTC) from Impact partner account 7439310; declined within minutes, so by an automatic rule. Shopify gives no feedback on declines, and its Impact panel has no message button, so there is no way to appeal. Impact shows a Re-apply button: use it once cinchstack.com has traffic of its own (about 1,000 visits a month), because the same profile is likely to be declined again. Shopify’s stated criteria: an active website, an established audience, original content, and experience with commerce or ecommerce platforms.

systeme-io.label: Systeme.io affiliate program
systeme-io.terms: 60% of every sale, recurring for as long as the customer stays subscribed; a lead who signs up through our link stays ours for life (last-cookie attribution). Paid on the 10th of each month once commissions pass $30, after a 30-day hold; no commission if the customer asks for a refund within 30 days.
systeme-io.payoutRail: PayPal or wire transfer. PayPal does not pay out to Pakistan, so use wire transfer, which systeme.io lets you add only after the first affiliate sale.

rateHistory.note: Joined at 60% lifetime recurring (automatic enrolment with a free account).

systeme-io.notes: Affiliate ID sa0282539325802d7f308f4a60a92b5eac51733968; ?sa= works on any systeme.io page, so buttons deep-link. The affiliate agreement (systeme.io/affiliate-agreement, “Brand promotion”) says affiliates “may not use any other competitor trademarks in your promotion of systeme.io”. Until systeme.io confirms that honest comparison pages are fine, paid links appear only on systeme.io’s own pages (its review and pricing page); comparison, alternatives and stack pages that name competitors keep plain links. To widen after written confirmation, delete rules.paidOnlyOn. systeme.io has no sub-IDs; Google Analytics affiliate_click events show which page sent each click. Self-referrals are excluded by the agreement.

semrush.label: Semrush affiliate program
semrush.terms: $200 per first purchase, plus a product bonus of $50 to $300 (Semrush One +$300; SEO Toolkit or Traffic & Market Toolkit +$200), $10 per free trial and $0.01 per registration. Last-click attribution with a 120-day click window. Actions lock 27 days after the month they are tracked and are paid 21 days after locking. Semrush can change the contract with 1 day’s notice.
semrush.payoutRail: Impact (bank details on file; Impact reviews them when the first payment falls due)
semrush.notes: Applied 27 September 2026 from Impact partner account 7439310 (display name “Rohail Nisar”; holds cinchstack.com, primary, and bestaicertifications.com). Impact applications come from the whole account, not one site. Pending under Discover > Invitations > Sent; a note linking the four CinchStack pages that feature Semrush was sent the same day through Impact’s message button (replies go to the account email). Semrush’s written rules (Program Information page and FAQ): minimum 1,000 unique monthly visitors, and “if your site is not yet live or has recently been launched, please consider applying later”, so a decline or hold is likely until traffic grows; re-apply then. No bidding on Semrush brand keywords or misspellings in paid ads, and all PPC must be pre-approved. No coupons, no references to non-existent discounts, and a free trial must not be presented as a coupon or discount. No Semrush trademarks in domain, social account or community names. FTC-style disclosure required, with no fixed wording (our disclosure line covers it). Use the tracking link exactly as Impact provides it, including its parameters; direct linking and ad hijacking are banned. Deep linking is supported. Self-referrals, cookie stuffing and misleading claims are banned. Semrush’s full affiliate terms, linked from its FAQ, have not been read yet: read them before the first link goes live. Once approved: create links for media property 8909960 (cinchstack.com) through Impact, with the page’s Sub ID in subId1, so reports separate CinchStack from the other site.
